original_bullet: Prove safe degraded operation and continuity arrangements.
existing_owner: Independent proof lane plus canonical/safety authority owners
next_action: On admitted isolated candidate inject stale/missing utility/provider data and restarts; demonstrate fail-closed containment, retained state, approved recovery and explicit handover authority with independent readback.
observed_evidence: Loss-prevention, sensitive-zone and water experiments provide local constraints, not live continuity/operational safety proof. Hosted exact-source recovery is still a release gate.
required_completion: Current exact integrated version; intended-role workflow; authoritative backend and durable state; refresh/fresh-login; applicable provider acceptance and independent readback; audit; independent security/recovery proof.
model_policy: Efficient available Sol/Codex for triage/development; independent reviewer; escalate only hard safety/security/payroll/recovery questions. Actual model selection/dispatch must be recorded, not assumed.
